svg.title: Confusion matrix
svg.desc: A two by two table. Columns: the detector rejects the cell, or passes it. Rows: the cell is defective, or good. Defective and rejected: TP, 7. Defective and passed: FN, 1. Good and rejected: FP, 2. Good and passed: TN, 30. The two error squares, FN and FP, are orange; the two correct squares are gray.
